description: Change order drafter — Draft a construction/project change order from a scope-change description: itemized costs (only amounts you gave), offline contract-sum math (original + prior changes + this change = new total, % of original, cumulative over 10% flagged), schedule adjustment and new completion date, assumptions, exclusions and signature blocks. Flags itemized vs stated total mismatches and unpriced items. Optional: original_amount, prior_changes, cost, days, completion YYYY-MM-DD, project, number. Price: $0.01 USDC (Base, via x402).

description.description: e.g. Owner requested upgrading lobby flooring from VCT to porcelain tile: tile and materials $8,400, labor $5,200. Adds 6 days.

name: ai_change_order
